items.abstract: The Trinity Group of Texas, Oklahoma, and Arkansas offers an intriguing opportunity to examine Early Cretaceous coastal ecosystems in the United States. Within Texas, the Trinity Group consists of the Twin Mountain, Glen Rose, and Paluxy formations, with the Antlers Formation being a lateral equivalent of the Texas formations located primarily in Oklahoma. The Antlers Formation represents fluvial, deltaic, and strand plain environments occurring within a transgressive–regressive sequence during the expansion of the Gulf of Mexico and Atlantic Ocean. The taphonomy of individual specimens and sites in the Antlers Formation has been previously evaluated but a formation-wide comparison of taphonomic characteristics has not yet been conducted. Antlers Formation sites produce organisms of varying size, ranging from mammals to large dinosaurs that inhabited terrestrial and freshwater to marginal marine environments. Preliminary findings show that teeth and jaw fragments of triconodont and multituberculate mammals, crocodyliforms, lissamphibians, chondrichthyians, and pycnodont and ceratodontid fish make up most of the material, typical of Early Cretaceous microsite assemblages. Testudines shell material and osteichthyan scales are extremely abundant at sites as well. Mammal material shows greater amounts of weathering and abrasion, compared to herpetofaunas, fish, sharks, and crocodyliforms, which consistently show minimal to moderate levels of surface modification. Dinosaur and pterosaur material display varying levels of weathering, abrasion, and crushing, with concentration and condition of site material possibly varying per stratigraphic location. Post-cranial Dinosaurian material is dominated by ornithopod and sauropod elements, which display lower quality preservation than microvertebrate material. Sauropod limb bones display higher degrees of rounding, abrasion and fragmentation. Ornithopod material varies in condition from moderately abraded, angular bone to heavily abraded and uniformly rounded. The taphonomic features of aquatic, semi-aquatic, and terrestrial faunas in Antlers assemblages help paint a picture of the accumulation processes in Mesozoic coastal ecosystems. This work also increases our understanding of the paleoenvironmental context of the Antlers Formation, allowing comparison to other Early Cretaceous faunas, such as the Cloverly Formation.
items.summary: 《鹿角组化石遗址埋藏学初步分析及对早白垩世古环境与动物群的评论》：该研究对俄克拉荷马州鹿角组开展组级埋藏学对比，分析哺乳类、龟鳖类、鱼类、恐龙等化石的风化与磨损差异，并探讨其古环境意义，可供了解早白垩世沿海生态系统埋藏过程的研究者参考。
items.title: Preliminary Taphonomic Analysis of Antlers Formation Fossil Sites and Comments on Early Cretaceous Paleoenvironment and Faunas

items.abstract: Abstract A new series of 11 radiocarbon (AMS) dates were obtained to the Biśnik Cave, one of the most important Central European sites. New AMS dates contributed to a more precise stratigraphic model for the complex sequence of sediments in this site. Received results showed that layer 1a is younger than 15 kyr, and layers 1b, 1 and 2 are dated on 25–15 kyr. Layers 4–3 were dated on 40–35 kyr, while layers 7–5 on 70-40 kyr. Layer 7 is the first and the uppermost strata in the whole profile out of the radiocarbon method. The new re-examination of chronology and fauna shed new light on the history of Biśnik fauna. The obtained UTh date of an age of 225 ± 27 kyr confirmed assignation layer 18 to MIS 7. Results of AMS dating were compared with optically stimulated luminescence (OSL), thermoluminescence (TL) and uranium-thorium dates as well as with results of biostratigraphic analysis. Results of data received from different direct dating methods (AMS, UTh, OSL, and TL) are confirmed also by data obtained from the biostratigraphic analysis. Only the maximum age of the lowermost sediments is still debatable. The whole, exceptionally abundant fauna, documented last ∼340 kyr, roughly between MIS 10/9-1. Among mammals, ancient species, early and mid-Middle Pleistocene faunal markers are absent.
items.summary: 《比希尼克洞穴地层学：新数据与解释》：该研究对比希尼克洞穴沉积序列开展11个放射性碳AMS测年，重建了各层年代框架，并将AMS结果与光释光、热释光和铀钍测年及生物地层分析相互印证，还确认第18层属MIS 7。适合关注中更新世地层学与年代学方法交叉验证的读者阅读。
items.title: Stratigraphy of Biśnik Cave: New data and interpretations

items.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    Methods for elucidating dietary patterns from dental morphology have provided much insight into molar form, function, and diet in extinct taxa. However, many methods rely on the collection of homologous landmarks (like shearing crest lengths), or computationally intensive and nuanced metrics that capture shape (like dental topography). Here, a new metric is proposed that is both simple to collect and that performs as well as other methods of linking tooth form and function. The angle at the cristid obliqua (ACO), a lower molar crest involved in the shearing phase of the power stroke, is measured as the angle between two lines derived from the hypoflexid to the middle of the cristid obliqua and then to the occlusal basin. The ACO was examined in a sample of extant lorisoid primates (
                    <jats:italic>N</jats:italic>
                     = 49 specimens) that have previously been examined using methods of dental topographic analysis. Results suggest that the ACO does not covary strongly with molar size or relative cristid obliqua length but is more strongly correlated with measures of dental topography such as relief and curvature. The ACO separates dietary groups (insectivores from exudativores and frugivores) almost as well as molar curvature and better than relief or cristid obliqua length. In general, insectivores have more strongly developed cristids obliquae for shearing insect carapaces and are therefore characterized by lower ACO values. Together, results suggest that the ACO provides further insight into molar form and function and this tool may be useful for examining dietary patterns in extinct primates and mammals more generally.
                  </jats:p>
items.summary: 《洛里斯类原猴斜嵴形态与食性的相关性》：研究提出测量下臼齿斜嵴角度这一简便新指标，在49件现生标本中检验其与牙齿尺寸、斜嵴相对长度及牙齿地形指标的关系，发现该角度能较好区分食虫、食胶与食果类群，为推断已绝灭灵长类及哺乳动物食性提供新工具。
items.title: Cristid obliqua morphology as a correlate of diet in lorisoids

items.abstract: Introduction This paper investigates a link between intra-regional climatic changes and the preservation of human remains and funerary textiles in a representative group of burials from the late Old Kingdom/early First Intermediate Period cemetery (5th–8th Dynasties; c. 2498–2160 BCE) at Saqqara West, Egypt. Methods The study integrates geological, geoarchaeological, and archaeological evidence from the site, contemporary with the 4.2ka BP aridification event, with macro- and microscopic bioarchaeological assessment of human remains, funerary textiles, and burial conditions. Results Human remains exhibited excellent preservation, with little to no evidence of weathering or cortical erosion. The varying state of textile preservation reflects a spectrum of burial microenvironments driven by a complex interplay between anthropogenic factors (underground shaft-tomb design; coffin materials) and environmental variables (bedrock porosity and permeability; pluvial water accumulation). Discussion By synthesizing multidisciplinary findings from the Saqqara West cemetery, this study demonstrates that the preservation of funerary textiles depended on the interaction between microclimatic events and burial attributes. These findings refine current understanding of the Old Kingdom burial practices, highlighting the value of organic remains as proxies for environmental and cultural changes.
items.summary: 《埃及萨卡拉西部古王国晚期墓葬中人类遗骸与丧葬纺织品保存的环境因素：埋葬微环境、埋藏学与保存偏差》：研究整合地质、考古与生物考古证据，探讨4.2千年前干旱化事件背景下墓葬微环境对遗骸与纺织品保存的影响，揭示人为与自然因素的复杂互动，值得关注。
items.title: Environmental factors in the preservation of human remains and funerary textiles in the late Old Kingdom burials at Saqqara West, Egypt: burial microenvironments, taphonomy, and preservation bias

items.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    Tectonic processes play a key role in the global mercury (Hg) cycle on geological timescales, by mobilising Hg from deep Earth reservoirs to the surface. These natural fluxes also introduce a dynamic component to the terrestrial Hg cycle that can interact with other environmental signals and influence Hg delivery to sedimentary records. For records extracted from tectonically active regions, this could complicate, obscure or even preclude accurate interpretation of sedimentary Hg responses to past centennial‐ to millennial‐scale environmental shifts. However, how this influence may translate to the sedimentary record remains unclear. Here, we present one of the longest (~100‐kyr) records of lacustrine Hg accumulation in the Arctic to date from Lake El'gygytgyn, an oligotrophic impact crater located in the remote north‐eastern Russia. Despite the lake's isolated location, anomalously high background Hg values point to a local (non‐atmospheric) source, which we posit is due to upward migration of Hg through faults beneath the lake floor. Superimposed onto this high background flux are a series of large (>900 ng g
                    <jats:sup>−1</jats:sup>
                    ) Hg peaks coeval with evidence for a cold and dry climate, characterised by perennial lake‐ice cover, a stratified water column and enhanced organic matter preservation in the sediments. Taken together, this suggests that Hg accumulation is linked to the unusual tectonic setting of Lake El'gygytgyn rather than external (atmospheric) supply, as has previously been observed in Arctic lakes. For example, higher Hg concentrations during phases of perennial ice cover suggest not only that certain climatic conditions further amplify the sedimentary signal from these local inputs, but also that Lake El'gygytgyn may act as a Hg source to the local environment during periods marked by reduced ice coverage.
                  </jats:p>
authors: Alice R. Paine, Joost Frieling, Bernd Wagner, Martin Melles, Volker Wennrich, Tamsin A. Mather, Stuart A. Robinson, David M. Pyle
items.summary: 《北极埃利吉吉特根湖末次冰期汞循环研究》：该研究利用俄罗斯东北部埃利吉吉特根湖约十万年的湖泊沉积记录，探讨汞积累与当地构造活动及气候条件的关系，提出异常高的背景汞值可能来自湖底断层上升迁移而非大气沉降，并发现汞峰值与寒冷干燥、常年冰盖等气候阶段同期。适合关注北极环境变化、汞循环与沉积记录的读者阅读。
items.title: Mercury cycling during the last glacial period in Arctic Lake El'gygytgyn, NE Russia

items.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    Dental pulp stem cells (DPSCs), a subset of mesenchymal stem/progenitor cells, exhibit remarkable self‐renewal and multipotent differentiation capacity, making them promising candidates for regenerative applications. While their
                    <jats:italic>in vitro</jats:italic>
                    characteristics have been extensively studied, the
                    <jats:italic>in vivo</jats:italic>
                    dynamics and molecular regulation during development are much less known. This study examined the embryonic/prenatal (E16.5) and early postnatal (P3.5 and P7.5) stages of mouse molar development to trace the temporospatial expression and overlap of five key molecules associated with DPSC: a trio of positive markers (CD73/
                    <jats:italic>Nt5e</jats:italic>
                    , CD90/
                    <jats:italic>Thy1</jats:italic>
                    , and CD105/
                    <jats:italic>Eng</jats:italic>
                    ) and two negative markers (CD34/
                    <jats:italic>Cd34</jats:italic>
                    and CD45/
                    <jats:italic>Ptprc</jats:italic>
                    ). Reanalysis of single‐cell RNA sequencing data revealed a triple‐positive and double‐negative population overlapping in the dental mesenchyme by P7.5. The results were confirmed by multiple immunofluorescence‐based
                    <jats:italic>in situ</jats:italic>
                    labeling. These findings contribute to the understanding of the spatiotemporal
                    <jats:italic>in vivo</jats:italic>
                    expression landscape and dynamics of DPSC markers, thus bridging the gap between
                    <jats:italic>in vitro</jats:italic>
                    characterization and the complex developmental reality of the dental pulp.
                  </jats:p>
authors: Kateřina Holomková, Shuntaro Yamada, Eva Švandová, Eva Matalová, Jesica Hasmik Hovhannisyan, Taleen Krikorian, Lidiia Bagdasarian, Sona Ayvazyan, Dino Azadians, Hervé Lesot, Eva Janečková
items.summary: 《基于单细胞RNA测序与免疫荧光分析探究牙髓中CD73、CD90和CD105的时空表达动态以建立三阳性细胞群》：该研究追踪小鼠磨牙发育胚胎期与出生后早期阶段，分析CD73、CD90、CD105三种阳性标志物及CD34、CD45两种阴性标志物的时空表达与重叠，发现至出生后7.5天牙间充质中出现三阳性双阴性细胞群，为理解牙髓干细胞标志物的体内表达动态提供了新视…

items.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    Nineteenth century excavations of the Ciply‐Malogne Phosphatic Chalk Formation in Hainaut, Belgium, yielded over 50 partial mosasaur skeletons, the majority of which were referred to the species
                    <jats:italic>Mosasaurus lemonnieri</jats:italic>
                    Dollo, 1889. In the years since, this taxon has experienced a complicated taxonomic history, and its exceptional hypodigm has gone understudied. Here, the osteology and variation of these specimens are described and figured in detail, with the goal of elucidating the taxonomy of these mosasaurs and improving anatomical understandings of mosasaurs in general. These specimens mostly show a unique and stable group of apomorphies, supporting their position as a distinct taxon in the genus
                    <jats:italic>Mosasaurus</jats:italic>
                    . Variation abounds, particularly in entheseal development, allometric robusticity, and cranial ossification patterns. Most of these specimens are juveniles or subadults, which has contributed to problematic past diagnoses for this species. We conclude that
                    <jats:italic>M</jats:italic>
                    .
                    <jats:italic>lemonnieri</jats:italic>
                    is a valid taxon, but that one specimen belongs to a distinct taxon of mosasaurine, here named
                    <jats:italic>Thoraxion tahlequahae</jats:italic>
                    gen. et sp. nov. The high degree of intraspecific variation in
                    <jats:italic>M. lemonnieri</jats:italic>
                    argues against the usage of several past taxonomic and phylogenetic characters. Several well‐preserved specimens allow for 3D reconstructions of the palate, rostral cranial cartilages, and ribcages of derived mosasaurs, and new putative pythonomorph synapomorphies of the cranial soft tissues.
                  </jats:p>
authors: Henry S. Sharpe, Hallie P. Street‐Sampson, Takuya Konishi, Michael W. Caldwell
items.summary: 《比利时西普利磷酸质白垩中并系沧龙类莱蒙尼沧龙组合的解剖学与变异》：该研究详细描述并图示了比利时海诺省出土的五十余件部分沧龙骨架，探讨其骨学特征与个体变异，确认莱蒙尼沧龙为有效分类单元，并命名一新属新种，同时指出其种内高变异度对既往分类与系统发育特征的质疑，还提供了腭部、吻部软骨与肋廓的三维重建，适合关注沧龙分类与解剖演化的读者阅读。
items.title: Anatomy and variation in the paraphyletic Mosasaurus lemonnieri assemblage from the Craie phosphatée de ciply, Belgium
